comments: WCAGsafe runs axe-core, the same engine as Google Lighthouse, plus six additional content checks (alt-text quality, link-text quality, heading order) that axe does not cover. Results are translated from WCAG technique codes into plain-English explanations for non-technical site owners. The Chrome extension runs entirely client-side, so it can test staging and authenticated pages without sending page content anywhere. WCAGsafe is a testing tool only — it does not inject, overlay, or modify page content.
features: Scans websites against WCAG 2.0 and 2.1 Level A/AA using axe-core plus extra checks for alt-text and link-text quality. Returns a 0–100 score, severity breakdown, and plain-English explanations with fix guidance per violation. Crawls whole sites or single pages; a free Chrome extension tests password-protected pages locally.
title: WCAGsafe
